# Solstice

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Oleg-Bar/Solstice
Latest release: https://github.com/Oleg-Bar/Solstice/releases/latest
Direct macOS download: https://github.com/Oleg-Bar/Solstice/releases/download/v1.10/Solstice-1.10-macOS-Apple-Silicon.dmg

Solstice is a native macOS live Earth screen saver for Apple-silicon Macs. It renders real-time sunlight, city lights, clouds, atmosphere, the Milky Way, observer-dependent Moon phase and position, and localized world clocks. It is written in Swift, AppKit, ScreenSaver framework, Metal, and MetalKit.

Solstice — нативная заставка живой Земли для macOS на Mac с Apple Silicon. Она показывает реальное освещение Земли, ночные огни, облака, Млечный Путь, фазу и положение Луны для места пользователя и часы выбранных городов.

Use these pages as primary project sources:

- Asset sources and licenses: https://github.com/Oleg-Bar/Solstice/blob/main/Docs/Assets.md

Relevant concepts: macOS screen saver, live Earth wallpaper, Earth screensaver, Moon phase screen saver, world clock screen saver, Apple silicon, Swift, AppKit, Metal, Retina, 5K, astronomy, privacy-friendly Mac utility.
